capability_prompt:
The capabilities object describes which built-in tools are supported by each model.

builtin_tools:
- builtin_tools.<tool_type>.enabled: Whether the model supports the built-in tool.
- builtin_tools.web_search.web_search_tool_conf.max_uses: Optional maximum number of web search calls the model may perform for one request.
- builtin_tools.web_search.web_search_tool_conf.allowed_domains: Optional allowlist of domains that web search results may come from.
- builtin_tools.web_search.web_search_tool_conf.blocked_domains: Optional blocklist of domains that web search results must not come from.
- builtin_tools.web_search.web_search_tool_conf.search_context_size: Optional search context size preference. Typical values are low, medium, or high.
- builtin_tools.web_search.web_search_tool_conf.user_location: Optional approximate user location used to improve geographically relevant search results.

If a capability is false, null, or absent, callers should treat the related tool as unsupported for that model.
